nodes.label: Planet Location Marker architecture (ARCHITECTURE.md)
Offline-first critical path (vendored three.js r170 and astronomy-engine 2.1.19, no CDN)
nodes.rationale: Nothing on the critical path needs the network; the only optional network use is online place search (open-meteo, then Photon, then Nominatim).

nodes.label: R1: Pure modules (astro, core, geo, data)
nodes.rationale: They run unchanged in Node tests and in the module worker; import maps do not apply inside workers or Node, so astronomy-engine is reached only through js/astro/ae.js by relative path.

nodes.label: R2: Only render, camera, main.js and app import three
nodes.rationale: Keeps the 3D engine swappable and the rest testable.

nodes.label: R3: UI never imports three or render
nodes.rationale: Text mode needs the UI to work without WebGL or import maps; the UI changes the app only through store, clock and actions.

nodes.label: R4: All URLs relative
nodes.rationale: The site is served from /planet-location-marker/ on GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: R5: No per-frame allocation
nodes.rationale: Steady memory; the smoke test checks geometry and texture counts at 1 day/s.

nodes.label: R6: Shader fragments end with tonemapping/colorspace includes
nodes.rationale: The includes are no-ops behind the composer and tone-map on the low tier's direct path.

nodes.label: R7: Float64Array vector and matrix conventions
nodes.rationale: One convention (Float64Array(3) vectors, row-major Float64Array(9), column-major Float64Array(16) for three) and no transposition bugs.

nodes.label: Dynamic import of UI and render stack from main.js
nodes.rationale: A browser without import maps still gets text mode; a broken UI module leaves the globe running and a broken render module leaves the panels running.

nodes.label: Text mode (no WebGL2 / no import maps fallback)
Boot sequence (10 steps, network never on the critical path)
Observer fallback chain (hash -> prefs -> largest city in device tz -> Greenwich)
Early downloads (generated modulepreload lists, preview preloads, prefetchTextures)
nodes.rationale: A cold boot would otherwise find its ~165 modules one import level at a time (five round trips to CopyShader.js) and the Earth maps would wait for all of them.

nodes.label: Shader compile behind the loader with held texture uploads (holdUploads)
nodes.rationale: An upload issued while the GPU process links shaders waits ~360 ms on the main thread versus a few ms afterwards; debug.checkShaderErrors stays on because turning it off only moved the wait and it reports shaders failing on exotic drivers.

nodes.label: Body classes (is-ready, is-sky, tier-*, no-webgl, is-intro, is-red)
State and data flow (UI -> actions -> store -> render modules; clock -> loop; bus readout)
Event jumps (jumpToEvent framed by eventFraming)
Sky dome all-sky chart (ui/sky-dome.js)
nodes.rationale: Text mode fetches the 175 KB sky.json rather than an embedded bright-star list: every 3D tier already has the catalogue, so an embedded list would cost every tier budget bytes only text mode uses.

nodes.label: Tonight chart and time-bar sky strip (series, sky-palette.js)
nodes.rationale: The 10-min altitude series rides along with the tonight report, so the charts cost no extra Astronomy Engine work.

nodes.label: Event glyphs and Add to calendar (.ics, RFC 5545)
Place search sky preview (placeSky from readout sub-points)
nodes.rationale: Needs no astronomy call: a body's altitude is 90 degrees minus the great-circle distance to its sub-point in the readout.

nodes.label: Sidereal tracking and the telescope (view.track, ui.scope)
Modes status stack, menus and Esc (ui/modes.js, dom.js menu)
Time bar and Time popover (ui/timebar.js)
Panels, phone tab bar and Display (five tabs, LAYER_GROUPS)
Eclipse in focus, path ribbon and Eclipse Companion (ui.eclipse)
Shadow chase (actions.chaseEclipse, rig.follow)
Long exposure (AccumPass max-stacking: star trails, analemma)
Capture for postcards and Save image (rc.capture in one task)
nodes.rationale: Renderer, composer and camera are set, drawn and restored before the task yields, so nothing is presented and nothing flashes.

nodes.label: Time-lapse video export (virtual time base, WebCodecs into mp4.js)
nodes.rationale: The recorder drives every frame on a virtual time base, so frames are deterministic whatever the GPU speed.

nodes.label: Idle supersampling (Halton jitter, SupersamplePass running mean)
Fast-time star streaks (render/streaks.js, STREAK_VERT_CHUNK)
Guided tours (app/tours.js runner, state capture and restore)
Vantage points (View from L1, Earthrise orbit; vantageNear depth)
Finding it in the real sky (edge chips, angle ruler, Find it, Point at the sky)
Flat world map (view.mode map, mapK morph in SURFACE_VERTEX)
Two places (observer2, snap.second, beams2/pin2)
Solar-system zoom (powers of ten, orrery overlay scene)
Frame vs full snapshot detail (0.5 s staleness, 4 Hz readout)
Extra objects registry (namespaced ids, providers, ExtraState)
nodes.rationale: The nine BODIES stay a contract; the star provider lists only the selected star, so 5,000 (or 41,000) stars never cost a registry slot each.

nodes.label: Nine BODIES order contract
Satellites TLE pipeline (daily staged refresh, network-first in sw.js)
nodes.rationale: A returning visitor gets the day's elements while the daily redeploy, which changes nothing else, is no new service-worker version; the page never contacts CelesTrak (R4).

nodes.label: Standing on Mars (store.host, slot 4 holds the Earth)
History: Julian dates, Moments and 'The sky you were born under'
Frame loop (js/app/loop.js, SPEC E.7)
Render on demand
nodes.rationale: A paused, idle app draws nothing; Live 1x redraws about twice a second when the snapshot goes stale.

nodes.label: Three-strikes module guard
nodes.rationale: A module that throws three times is hidden with one toast; a renderer that keeps throwing hands over to text mode.

nodes.label: RenderModule contract (object3d, apply, update, setLayers, setViewMode, setSelection, setQuality, dispose)
Time-driven hiding via material.visible or zero instances, not object visible
nodes.rationale: three uploads a geometry the first time it projects an object; hiding with visible=false would upload buffers mid-run, which the smoke test's memory-stable check sees as a new geometry.

nodes.label: Fixed render order (SPEC E.1)
Planet medallions (render/planets.js, PLANET_CHUNK impostor)
One shared horizon profile
nodes.rationale: Ground, bodies, flare and labels test the same silhouette, so a body behind a hill is neither drawn, labelled as up, clickable nor flaring.

nodes.label: Globe <-> sky transition (skyBlend, groundCover, descent pitch-up)
Label anchors, priorities and UI occluders (no layout reads in a frame)
Quality tiers (low / medium / high / max)
Max tier (manual only, no budget, 8K maps)
Downgrade-only quality governor (display-cadence budget, learned tier)
nodes.rationale: The budget follows the display's own frame interval so a 30 Hz Energy Saver cap or a 48 Hz panel does not read as a slow GPU; a learned tier spares the same GPU the switch hitch on every visit.

nodes.label: Staged hitch-free tier switch (pause, stage, compile, commit, resume)
nodes.rationale: Its first frame compiles and uploads nothing; the main thread, panels and input stay live through the compile.

nodes.label: 512 px Earth previews on every tier (uSharpen sharpen-in)
Closing decoded ImageBitmaps after upload
nodes.rationale: Saves 33.5 MB of RAM per 4096x2048 map and 134 MB per 8192x4096; a context restore or anisotropy change re-fetches from the HTTP or service-worker cache.

nodes.label: One planet on every tier (2k maps derived from 4k)
nodes.rationale: A Quality change or governor step changes sharpness and effects, never colours, coastlines or weather.

nodes.label: Failure handling matrix
WebGL context-loss pause and restore
Context-loss backoff (60 s window: restore, one tier lower, text mode)
Service worker (staged version-atomic manifest; dev network-first)
nodes.rationale: Cache-first within a version so a page never mixes versions; no skipWaiting, so an update waits and offers a reload.

nodes.label: URL hash format (loc, t, r, sel, ly, cam, q, tour, vt, host, lang)
window.__app debug API (ready, snapshot, stats, sw)
Copy diagnostics report (no location, allowlisted hash keys)
Headless Chrome smoke test (all external hosts blocked)
Performance gates (programs, draw calls, frame counts, layout reads)
nodes.rationale: Gate on counts, never milliseconds: CI runners are noisy and SwiftShader is slow, but a count moves only when the code does.

nodes.label: Golden renders visual regression (pinned Chrome for Testing)
Per-tier transfer budgets (low 5.2 / medium 5.975 / high 8 MB, 32 MB deploy)
Code conventions (ES2022 modules, JSDoc, no TypeScript or bundler)
Night vision CSS filter chain (html.is-red)
nodes.rationale: Three colour-matrix functions, never an SVG url() filter (which leaves the GPU path in Safari and Firefox); kept out of the URL hash because it is a preference of the observing device.

nodes.label: Visual system tokens, contrast and system preferences
Strings and locales (gettext-style, English text as key; t/tn/N_)
nodes.rationale: Whole phrases with placeholders because word order differs between languages; the astro worker receives the locale table as its first message.
